cn.name: 证伪主义/可证伪性
cn.description: 一个理论要有价值，必须存在有可能证明它是错误的情形；不可证伪的理论没有科学价值。
trigger: 判断一个理论是否科学
avoid_when: 讨论形而上学或价值命题时
transform: 找出该理论的潜在反例
检验理论是否允许反例存在
可证伪则保留并不断修正
cn.agent_instruction: 评估一个主张时，先问：什么证据能证明它错？如果没有任何情形能证明它错，它就不具备科学价值。
cn.source_text: 卡尔·波普尔《科学发现的逻辑》（1934）。

en.name: Falsifiability
en.description: A theory is valuable only if there is a possible observation that could prove it wrong; unfalsifiable theories lack scientific value.
trigger: Judging whether a theory is scientific
Evaluating the value of a hypothesis
avoid_when: When discussing metaphysical or value propositions
transform: Identify potential counterexamples
Check whether the theory permits counterexamples
Keep revising falsifiable theories
en.agent_instruction: When evaluating a claim, ask first: what evidence could prove it wrong? If nothing could, it has no scientific value.
en.source_text: Karl Popper, The Logic of Scientific Discovery (1934).

cn.name: 合成谬误
cn.description: 对局部成立的东西，仅仅因为它对局部成立，就断言它对整体也必然成立。
trigger: 从个体特征推断整体特征
论证中出现'每个人……所以整体……'
avoid_when: 整体确实是部分的简单加总时（少数情形）
transform: 区分局部性质与整体性质
检查部分之间是否存在相互作用
寻找反例（如公地悲剧）
cn.agent_instruction: 从'每个部分都……'推出'所以整体也……'之前，先检查部分之间是否存在相互作用或结构效应。
cn.source_text: 由萨缪尔森提出（原文标注）。

en.name: Fallacy of Composition
en.description: Assuming that what is true for a part must also be true for the whole, merely because it is true for the part.
trigger: Arguments of the form 'everyone... so the whole...'
avoid_when: When the whole is a simple additive sum of parts (rare)
transform: Distinguish properties of parts from properties of the whole
Check for interactions among parts
Look for counterexamples such as the tragedy of the commons
en.agent_instruction: Before inferring 'so the whole...' from 'every part...', check whether interactions among parts create structural effects.
en.source_text: Attributed to Paul Samuelson (as noted in the source text).

cn.name: 分解谬误
cn.description: 整体具有某种性质，就断言其每一部分或元素也具有该性质。
trigger: 从整体属性推断个体属性
论证中出现'……很强，所以每个成员都强'
transform: 区分整体性质与个体性质
检查属性是否在整体与部分之间可转移
寻找反例
cn.agent_instruction: 从整体性质推断个体性质之前，先检验该性质是否能在整体与部分之间转换。
cn.source_text: 示例出处：请替换为可追溯的书名、作者或原始资料说明。

en.name: Fallacy of Division
en.description: Assuming that if a whole has a property, every part or element of it must also have that property.
trigger: Inferring individual traits from group traits
Arguments of the form 'the team is strong, so every member is strong'
transform: Distinguish properties of wholes from properties of parts
Check whether the property transfers
Look for counterexamples
en.agent_instruction: Before inferring part-level properties from whole-level properties, verify that the property actually transfers.
en.source_text: Example source: replace with a traceable book, author, or original material.

cn.name: 巴纳姆效应
cn.description: 人们倾向于接受模糊、泛泛而谈的描述，并认为它精确适用于自己。
trigger: 评估星座、性格测试、算命等描述时
transform: 识别描述是否模糊通用
检查它是否适用于几乎所有人
用他人检验该描述
cn.agent_instruction: 面对'说中了你'的性格描述时，先检查这条描述是否对任何人都成立。
cn.source_text: 1948 年伯特伦·福勒（Bertram Forer）提出。

en.name: Barnum Effect
en.description: People tend to accept vague, general statements as accurate descriptions of themselves.
trigger: Evaluating horoscopes, personality tests, or fortune-telling statements
transform: Check whether the statement is vague and generic
Test whether it applies to almost everyone
Try the statement on other people
en.agent_instruction: When a personality description feels accurate, check whether it would feel accurate to anyone.
en.source_text: Bertram Forer, 1948.

cn.name: 知识诅咒
cn.description: 掌握知识的人很难想象缺乏这种知识的人的状态，从而导致表达不清和沟通失败。
trigger: 设计教学、文档、产品说明
transform: 先盘点受众已知什么、未知什么
用具体例子替代行话
让目标受众实测理解程度
cn.agent_instruction: 表达前先切换到听众视角：他们脑子里没有你知道的背景，把抽象内容落到具体例子上。
cn.source_text: 源于 1990 年伊丽莎白·牛顿在斯坦福所做的'敲击者与听众'实验。

en.name: Curse of Knowledge
en.description: People who know something find it hard to imagine what it is like not to know it, causing unclear communication.
trigger: Designing teaching material, docs, or product instructions
transform: Inventory what the audience knows and does not know
Replace jargon with concrete examples
Test comprehension on real audience members
en.agent_instruction: Before communicating, switch to the listener's perspective: they lack your background, so anchor abstract content in concrete examples.
en.source_text: Elizabeth Newton's 1990 Stanford 'tappers and listeners' experiment.

cn.name: 自证陷阱
cn.description: 急于自证清白时反而陷入对方预设的逻辑困境，越解释越被动。
trigger: 被贴标签、被冤枉、被要求自证时
avoid_when: 在需要澄清事实的正式程序中（举证责任明确时）
transform: 识别对方是否在审判者位置贴标签
记住'谁质疑谁举证'
把自证变成他证，跳出对方逻辑
cn.agent_instruction: 面对质疑时不要急于自证——把举证责任交还对方，要求对方先拿出证据。
cn.source_text: 原文引《让子弹飞》胡万情节作为例子。

en.name: Self-proof Trap
en.description: Rushing to prove one's innocence traps you in the accuser's frame; the more you explain, the more passive you become.
trigger: Being labeled, accused, or demanded to prove yourself
avoid_when: In formal procedures with clear burden of proof
transform: Notice if the other party is judging and labeling you
Remember: whoever questions must provide evidence
Shift from self-proof to demanding their proof
en.agent_instruction: When challenged, do not rush to justify yourself—return the burden of proof and ask the challenger for evidence first.
en.source_text: Source text uses a scene from Let the Bullets Fly (Hu Wan) as an example.

cn.name: 大数定理
cn.description: 随着样本数增加，样本均值趋近于总体均值，随机事件的平均值具有稳定性和可预测性。
trigger: 判断随机事件长期趋势
avoid_when: 小样本、非独立样本情形下推断个体结果
transform: 确认样本随机且独立
扩大样本量
用样本均值估计总体均值
cn.agent_instruction: 用样本推断总体前先检查样本的随机性和数量，样本越大，均值估计越可靠。
cn.source_text: 示例出处：请替换为可追溯的书名、作者或原始资料说明。

en.name: Law of Large Numbers
en.description: As the sample size grows, the sample mean converges to the population mean, making averages of random events stable and predictable.
trigger: Estimating a population from a sample
Judging long-run trends of random events
avoid_when: Inferring individual outcomes from small or non-independent samples
transform: Verify the sample is random and independent
Increase the sample size
Estimate the population mean from the sample mean
en.agent_instruction: Before inferring a population from a sample, check the sample's randomness and size; larger samples give more reliable means.
en.source_text: Example source: replace with a traceable book, author, or original material.

cn.name: 均值回归
cn.description: 价格或价值偏离长期平均水平后，总体趋势是向其历史均值回落。
trigger: 价格或表现极端偏离历史水平
评估业绩是能力还是运气
avoid_when: 存在结构性变化使旧均值失效时
transform: 确定长期均值参考线
识别当前偏离程度
判断回归动力与结构性例外
cn.agent_instruction: 看到极端高或极端低的表现时，先问：这是能力变化，还是只是偏离均值后的必然回落？
cn.source_text: 1886 年 Francis Galton 研究人类身高时发现，称之为'回归平庸'。

en.name: Mean Reversion
en.description: Prices or values that deviate from their long-run average tend to move back toward it.
trigger: Prices or performance deviate extremely from historical levels
Assessing whether success is skill or luck
avoid_when: When structural changes invalidate the old mean
transform: Establish the long-run mean as reference
Measure the current deviation
Judge reversion forces and structural exceptions
en.agent_instruction: When you see extreme highs or lows, ask first: is this a change in ability, or an inevitable pullback from the mean?
en.source_text: Discovered by Francis Galton in 1886 while studying human height ('regression to mediocrity').

cn.name: 马太效应
cn.description: 因起始条件不平等，优势者获得更多资源和机会，劣势者进一步落后，不平等自我放大。
trigger: 分析教育、财富、平台中的两极分化
评估起步优势的长期影响
transform: 识别初始条件差异
追踪资源与机会的反馈循环
寻找打破循环的干预点
cn.agent_instruction: 看到'强者愈强'的现象时，追溯其初始条件差异和正反馈回路，而不是归因于个人品质。
cn.source_text: 社会学家罗伯特·K·莫顿（Robert K. Merton）1968 年提出，灵感来自《圣经》马太福音。

en.name: Matthew Effect
en.description: Initial inequality compounds: the advantaged gain more resources and opportunities while the disadvantaged fall further behind.
trigger: Analyzing polarization in education, wealth, or platforms
Evaluating long-term effects of head starts
transform: Identify initial condition gaps
Trace the feedback loop of resources and opportunities
Find intervention points that break the loop
en.agent_instruction: When you see 'the strong get stronger', trace initial-condition gaps and positive-feedback loops instead of attributing it to personal merit.
en.source_text: Coined by sociologist Robert K. Merton in 1968, inspired by the Gospel of Matthew.

cn.name: 赌徒谬误
cn.description: 错误地认为独立随机事件的概率会被之前的结果改变。
trigger: 连续出现同一结果后判断下一次概率
任何'该轮到我了'式的推理
avoid_when: 事件确实存在自相关（非独立）时
transform: 确认事件是否独立
若独立，则历史结果不改变下一次概率
按真实概率决策
cn.agent_instruction: 判断'下一次'的概率前，先确认事件之间是否真的相关；独立事件没有'该轮到'一说。
cn.source_text: 示例出处：请替换为可追溯的书名、作者或原始资料说明。

en.name: Gambler's Fallacy
en.description: The erroneous belief that the odds of an independent random event are changed by previous outcomes.
trigger: Judging the next outcome after a streak
avoid_when: When events are genuinely autocorrelated (not independent)
transform: Verify whether the events are independent
If independent, past outcomes do not change the next probability
Decide by true probabilities
en.agent_instruction: Before judging the odds of 'the next one', verify whether the events are truly related; independent events have no 'due' moment.
en.source_text: Example source: replace with a traceable book, author, or original material.

cn.name: 赌徒输光定理
cn.description: 在重复博弈中，赌徒以很高概率最终输光全部赌资；目标越大、赌注越大，输光概率越高。
trigger: 评估重复下注、加杠杆的风险
判断'赢了就走'策略是否可行
transform: 确认赌局独立且胜率
用 P(a)=1-a/b 估算输光概率
输光概率高时退出游戏或降低暴露
cn.agent_instruction: 任何'不断加注、最终一把翻身'的策略，先用赌徒输光定理算一算归零概率。
cn.source_text: 原文参考：https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Wb411c7ig

en.name: Gambler's Ruin
en.description: In repeated betting, a gambler has a high probability of losing the entire bankroll; the bigger the target and stakes, the higher the ruin probability.
trigger: Assessing repeated betting or leveraged risk
Judging whether a 'win and walk away' strategy works
transform: Confirm the game is independent with known win rate
Estimate ruin probability with P(a)=1-a/b
If ruin probability is high, exit or reduce exposure
en.agent_instruction: For any 'keep raising and win it all back eventually' strategy, compute the ruin probability first.
en.source_text: Source text cites: https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Wb411c7ig

cn.name: 回音室效应
cn.description: 封闭环境中相近意见被不断重复和扭曲，使身处其中的人把扭曲的故事当成事实的全部。
transform: 识别信息源是否单一
主动接触对立观点
多问几个为什么并反思
cn.agent_instruction: 定期检查自己的信息食谱：如果所有来源都同意你，你很可能在回音室里。
cn.source_text: 心理学家凯斯·桑斯坦（Cass Sunstein）提出。

en.name: Echo Chamber Effect
en.description: In a closed environment, similar opinions repeat and distort until occupants mistake the distorted story for the whole truth.
transform: Check whether sources are single-sided
Deliberately seek opposing views
Ask why repeatedly and reflect
en.agent_instruction: Audit your information diet regularly: if every source agrees with you, you are probably in an echo chamber.
en.source_text: Proposed by psychologist Cass Sunstein.

cn.name: 破窗效应
cn.description: 环境中的失序信号若不及时修复，会被模仿和放大，导致问题恶化。
trigger: 环境中出现未被纠正的不良现象
avoid_when: 用于为过度执法或歧视性治理辩护时
transform: 及时发现环境中的'破窗'
第一时间修复和纠正
建立防再发的机制
cn.agent_instruction: 看到第一个'破窗'——第一个未被处理的违规、缺陷、失信——立即修复，不要等它变成常态。
cn.source_text: 由詹姆士·威尔逊（James Q. Wilson）和乔治·凯林（George L. Kelling）提出。

en.name: Broken Windows Theory
en.description: Untended signs of disorder invite imitation and escalation, causing problems to worsen if not promptly fixed.
trigger: Unchecked bad behavior in the environment
avoid_when: When used to justify over-policing or discriminatory enforcement
transform: Spot the first 'broken window' early
Fix and correct it immediately
Build mechanisms that prevent recurrence
en.agent_instruction: When you see the first broken window—the first unaddressed violation, defect, or breach of trust—fix it immediately before it becomes the norm.
en.source_text: Proposed by James Q. Wilson and George L. Kelling.

cn.name: 基本归因错误
cn.description: 解释他人行为时高估个性等内在因素，低估情境因素。
trigger: 出现'他一定是故意的'式判断
transform: 先列出可能的情境因素
再考虑个性因素
对比两种解释的证据强度
cn.agent_instruction: 评判他人之前，先问：换成是我在他的处境里，我会怎么做？
cn.source_text: 研究者李·罗斯（Lee Ross）对该错误进行了解释（原文标注）。

en.name: Fundamental Attribution Error
en.description: When explaining others' behavior, overemphasizing dispositional factors and underestimating situational factors.
trigger: Explaining why someone acted a certain way
Judgments like 'he must have done it on purpose'
transform: List possible situational factors first
Then consider dispositional factors
Compare the evidence for both
en.agent_instruction: Before judging someone, ask: what would I have done in their situation?
en.source_text: Explained by researcher Lee Ross (as noted in the source text).

cn.name: 幸存者偏差
cn.description: 只观察到幸存样本而忽略被淘汰者，导致对总体的判断出现系统性偏差。
trigger: 分析成功案例总结'成功学'
transform: 问'没回来的飞机在哪里'
主动寻找看不见的样本
用全量数据替代可见样本
cn.agent_instruction: 研究成功者之前，先找出失败者在哪里、他们为什么没被统计到。
cn.source_text: 二战美军轰炸机装甲案例：哥伦比亚大学沃德教授（Abraham Wald）主张加强引擎与机尾。

en.name: Survivorship Bias
en.description: Observing only surviving samples while ignoring those that failed leads to systematically skewed conclusions about the whole.
trigger: When failure cases are missing from data
transform: Ask where the missing samples are
Actively search for invisible cases
Replace visible samples with complete data
en.agent_instruction: Before studying successes, find out where the failures are and why they were never counted.
en.source_text: WWII US bomber armor case: Abraham Wald of Columbia argued for reinforcing engines and tails.

cn.name: 群体极化
cn.description: 群体讨论使成员观点趋向极端，中间立场减少。
trigger: 争议性议题的群体讨论
transform: 识别观点是否在向极端漂移
引入异质信息和反方角色
保护中间立场的表达空间
cn.agent_instruction: 群体讨论后如果共识更强、更绝对了，警惕这不是'想清楚了'，而是极化了。
cn.source_text: 示例出处：请替换为可追溯的书名、作者或原始资料说明。

en.name: Group Polarization
en.description: Group discussion drives members' views toward extremes while the middle ground shrinks.
transform: Detect drift toward extremes
Introduce heterogeneous information and dissenting roles
Protect room for middle-ground voices
en.agent_instruction: If a group discussion ends with stronger, more absolute consensus, suspect polarization rather than clearer thinking.
en.source_text: Example source: replace with a traceable book, author, or original material.

cn.name: 冗余备份模型
cn.description: 为关键部件创建多个副本并分散存储，用冗余换取可靠性和可用性。
trigger: 设计不能单点失效的系统
avoid_when: 成本或复杂性远超故障损失时
transform: 识别关键部件
创建多副本并异地分布
解决副本一致性同步
cn.agent_instruction: 任何'坏了就完了'的部件，默认给它做冗余：多副本、异地、可恢复。
cn.source_text: 工程学模型（原文标注，更新日期 2023/7/8）。

en.name: Redundancy Backup Model
en.description: Create multiple copies of critical components and distribute them to trade redundancy for reliability and availability.
trigger: Designing systems that must not have a single point of failure
avoid_when: When cost or complexity far exceeds the loss from failure
transform: Identify critical components
Create multiple copies across locations
Solve consistency among copies
en.agent_instruction: For any component whose failure is fatal, default to redundancy: multiple copies, offsite, recoverable.
en.source_text: Engineering model (noted in source text, updated 2023/7/8).

cn.name: 复利模型
cn.description: 利息加入本金后继续产生利息，增长随时间呈指数级放大。
trigger: 评估习惯、知识的长期积累
avoid_when: 利率或频率剧烈波动时直接套用公式
transform: 确定本金与利率
确认复利频率
推演多期增长并考虑通胀、税收
cn.agent_instruction: 评估任何'长期积累'的事物（金钱、能力、用户）时，用复利视角看它的指数后半段，而不只是线性前半段。
cn.source_text: 数学模型（原文标注，2023/7/9）。

en.name: Compound Interest Model
en.description: Interest is added to the principal and itself earns interest, producing exponential growth over time.
trigger: Evaluating long-term accumulation of habits or knowledge
avoid_when: When rates or frequency fluctuate sharply
transform: Set principal and rate
Confirm compounding frequency
Project multi-period growth with inflation and taxes
en.agent_instruction: When assessing anything that accumulates over time (money, skill, users), look at the exponential second half, not just the linear first half.
en.source_text: Mathematical model (noted in source text, 2023/7/9).

cn.name: 网络巴尔干化
cn.description: 算法推荐与选择性接触使网络群体内部同质化、群体间隔绝，信息空间碎片化。
trigger: 分析舆论撕裂、信息孤岛
transform: 识别群体内的同质化强化
识别群体间的隔离结构
主动跨圈获取信息
cn.agent_instruction: 发现自己的信息流里完全没有反对声音时，这就是网络巴尔干化的入口。
cn.source_text: MIT 教授马歇尔·范·阿尔斯泰（Marshall Van Alstyne）与埃里克·布林约尔松（Erik Brynjolfsson）1997 年提出。

en.name: Cyber-Balkanization
en.description: Algorithmic recommendation and selective exposure make online groups homogeneous internally and isolated from each other, fragmenting the information space.
trigger: Analyzing opinion fragmentation and information islands
transform: Identify in-group homogenization
Identify inter-group isolation
Deliberately cross information boundaries
en.agent_instruction: When your feed contains no opposing voices at all, you are at the entrance of cyber-balkanization.
en.source_text: Proposed by MIT professors Marshall Van Alstyne and Erik Brynjolfsson in 1997.

cn.name: 蒙特卡洛法
cn.description: 通过大量随机抽样和统计模拟，为无法解析求解的复杂问题给出数值解。
trigger: 需要评估复杂系统的概率分布
avoid_when: 精度要求高但算力不足时
可以解析求解的简单问题
transform: 为问题建立概率模型
大量随机抽样
统计样本结果收敛到近似解
cn.agent_instruction: 当一个问题算不出精确解时，把它变成一个概率模型，用大量随机试验逼出近似答案。
cn.source_text: 统计学方法（原文标注，2023/7/11）。

en.name: Monte Carlo Method
en.description: Solve complex problems numerically through massive random sampling and statistical simulation.
trigger: Estimating probability distributions of complex systems
avoid_when: When high precision is required but compute is limited
Simple problems solvable analytically
transform: Build a probabilistic model
Sample massively at random
Aggregate samples into a converged approximation
en.agent_instruction: When a problem has no closed-form solution, turn it into a probability model and approximate the answer with massive random trials.
en.source_text: Statistical method (noted in source text, 2023/7/11).

cn.name: 奥卡姆剃刀

主动与不同群体交流
用调查数据替代猜测
cn.agent_instruction: '大家都这么认为'之前，先数一下：你这个'大家'到底有几个人、都是谁？
cn.source_text: 社会心理学家 Ross 与 Koenig 1977 年提出（原文标注）。

en.name: False Consensus Effect
en.description: Overestimating how much others agree with you, assuming everyone thinks the same way.
trigger: Consensus judgment inside a small circle
transform: List where your view could be wrong
Talk to different groups
Replace guessing with survey data
en.agent_instruction: Before saying 'everyone thinks so', count: how many people is your 'everyone', and who are they?
en.source_text: Proposed by social psychologists Ross and Koenig in 1977 (as noted in the source text).

cn.name: 分析瘫痪
cn.description: 选择过多、分析过度导致迟迟无法决策，错失机会。
avoid_when: 高风险决策确实需要充分分析时
transform: 明确核心目标
只比较关键因素
设定决策截止时间
cn.agent_instruction: 信息收集超过一个临界点就递减价值；设一个 deadline，到点用现有信息拍板。
cn.source_text: 示例出处：请替换为可追溯的书名、作者或原始资料说明。

en.name: Analysis Paralysis
en.description: Too many options and over-analysis freeze decision-making and cost opportunities.
avoid_when: High-stakes decisions that genuinely require full analysis
transform: Clarify the core goal
Compare only key factors
Set a decision deadline
en.agent_instruction: Information gathering has diminishing returns past a threshold; set a deadline and decide with what you have.
en.source_text: Example source: replace with a traceable book, author, or original material.

cn.name: 频率错觉
cn.description: 注意到某事物后，会觉得它出现的频率突然变高了，其实只是你的注意力变了。
trigger: 刚买车后觉得满街都是同款
刚学新概念后到处看见它
transform: 区分'频率变了'和'注意力变了'
用计数或数据验证
警惕据此高估事物重要性
cn.agent_instruction: '最近怎么到处都是……'——先用数据验证，很可能只是你开始注意了。
cn.source_text: 示例出处：请替换为可追溯的书名、作者或原始资料说明。

en.name: Frequency Illusion
en.description: After noticing something, it seems to appear far more often, when only your attention has changed.
trigger: Seeing your new car model everywhere
Noticing a new concept all around
transform: Separate 'frequency changed' from 'attention changed'
Verify with counts or data
Beware of overestimating importance
en.agent_instruction: 'Why is X everywhere lately'—verify with data first; you probably just started noticing it.
en.source_text: Example source: replace with a traceable book, author, or original material.

cn.name: 规划谬误
cn.description: 预测工期时只考虑最佳情况，系统性低估完成所需时间。
avoid_when: 紧急任务中乐观估计有动员作用时（有限适用）
transform: 参考过去同类任务的实际耗时
逐项分解步骤并计入障碍
加缓冲并跟踪复盘
cn.agent_instruction: 估工期时别问'顺利的话要多久'，去翻上一个类似项目实际花了多久。
cn.source_text: 示例出处：请替换为可追溯的书名、作者或原始资料说明。

en.name: Planning Fallacy
en.description: Time estimates consider only the best case, systematically underestimating completion time.
avoid_when: In emergencies where optimism mobilizes (limited use)
transform: Reference actual durations of similar past tasks
Break into steps including obstacles
Add buffer and track afterwards
en.agent_instruction: When estimating, do not ask 'how long if all goes well'—look up how long the last similar project actually took.
en.source_text: Example source: replace with a traceable book, author, or original material.

cn.name: 零风险偏差
cn.description: 人们过度偏好把风险降为零的选项，即使代价远高于收益。
trigger: 出现'彻底消除风险'的选项时
transform: 比较降低风险的边际成本与边际收益
接受可控的小风险换取更大回报
识别'零风险'选项的真实代价
cn.agent_instruction: 为了最后 1% 的风险消除付出不成比例的代价前，算算边际收益是否值得。
cn.source_text: 示例出处：请替换为可追溯的书名、作者或原始资料说明。

en.name: Zero-Risk Bias
en.description: People over-prefer options that reduce risk to zero, even at disproportionate cost.
trigger: When an 'eliminate risk entirely' option appears
transform: Compare marginal cost and benefit of risk reduction
Accept manageable small risks for larger returns
Spot the real cost of 'zero risk' options
en.agent_instruction: Before paying a disproportionate price to eliminate the last 1% of risk, compute whether the marginal benefit is worth it.
en.source_text: Example source: replace with a traceable book, author, or original material.

cn.name: 韵律当理由效应
cn.description: 押韵、顺口的句子被认为更真实、更有道理，即使内容毫无根据。
transform: 把韵律和内容分开评估
只审查命题本身的事实与逻辑
警惕自己用押韵记忆替代验证
cn.agent_instruction: '说得顺口'和'说得对'是两回事；把口号翻译成普通句子再判断真伪。
cn.source_text: 示例出处：请替换为可追溯的书名、作者或原始资料说明。

en.name: Rhyme as Reason Effect
en.description: Rhyming, fluent statements are judged as more truthful and reasonable even when contentless.
transform: Separate fluency from content
Judge the proposition on facts and logic
Beware of substituting memorability for verification
en.agent_instruction: 'Sounds good' and 'is true' are different things; rewrite the slogan as a plain sentence before judging it.
en.source_text: Example source: replace with a traceable book, author, or original material.

cn.name: 皮糙肉厚偏见
cn.description: 认为吃过苦的人对新的痛苦更不敏感，从而系统性低估弱势者的痛苦。
trigger: 评估他人的痛苦与需求
制定对弱势群体的支持政策
transform: 识别'吃过苦=更耐痛'的默认假设
了解未愈合创伤会放大而非缓冲伤害
按真实需求而非推测的承受力分配支持
cn.agent_instruction: 不要因为某人'习惯了吃苦'就低估他的痛苦——未经愈合的伤口只会一碰就大出血。
cn.source_text: 示例出处：请替换为可追溯的书名、作者或原始资料说明。

en.name: Thick Skin Bias
en.description: Assuming people who have suffered are less sensitive to new suffering, systematically underestimating the pain of the disadvantaged.
transform: Spot the default 'suffered before = tougher' assumption
Learn that unhealed trauma amplifies rather than buffers harm
Allocate support by real need, not assumed tolerance
en.agent_instruction: Never discount someone's pain because they are 'used to hardship'—unhealed wounds bleed at the slightest touch.
en.source_text: Example source: replace with a traceable book, author, or original material.

cn.name: 优绩主义陷阱
cn.description: 成功者把成功全部归因于努力，从而傲慢地轻视'不够努力'的失败者，忘记运气与时代。
trigger: '你穷是因为你不努力'式论断
成功者评估自己的成就来源
transform: 盘点成功中的运气与助力因素
对失败者保持谦卑
区分'努力的运气'与'努力的价值'
cn.agent_instruction: 评价任何人的成败时，把家庭、时代、机遇放回等式——成功从来不只是个人努力的产物。
cn.source_text: 迈克尔·桑德尔（Michael Sandel）相关论述（《优绩的暴政》The Tyranny of Merit）。

en.name: Meritocracy Trap
en.description: Winners attribute success solely to effort, becoming arrogantly contemptuous of 'insufficiently hardworking' losers, forgetting luck and timing.
trigger: Winners auditing the sources of their success
transform: Inventory luck and help in your success
Stay humble toward the less fortunate
Separate the luck of effort from the value of effort
en.agent_instruction: When judging anyone's success or failure, put family, era, and chance back into the equation—success is never the product of effort alone.
en.source_text: Michael Sandel, The Tyranny of Merit.

cn.name: 二律背反
cn.description: 理性研究某些超验命题会得出自相矛盾的答案，这类问题在可认知范围之外。
trigger: 一个争论双方都'有理'且无法验证
transform: 识别命题是否超出可验证范围
用可证伪性/萨根标准检验
无法证明的命题标记为'无意义'并放下
cn.agent_instruction: 对一个争不清的问题，先问：它原则上可被验证吗？不可验证就不要再浪费精力。
cn.source_text: 康德哲学概念（原文未标注，仅作背景）。

en.name: Antinomy
en.description: Reason applied to certain transcendent propositions yields contradictory answers; such questions lie outside cognition.
trigger: Debates where both sides 'have a point' and nothing is verifiable
transform: Check whether the proposition is verifiable in principle
Test with falsifiability and Sagan's standard
Mark unprovable propositions as meaningless and move on
en.agent_instruction: For an endless dispute, ask first: can it in principle be verified? If not, stop spending energy on it.
en.source_text: Kantian philosophical concept (background note).

cn.name: 笛卡尔思维模型
cn.description: 对任何观点保持怀疑，把难题层层分解，先易后难整合，再全面检验。
trigger: 面对复杂难题无从下手
需要验证一个流行说法
avoid_when: 时间紧迫需要快速直觉判断时
transform: 不轻易接纳观点
把难题分层分模块拆解
先易后难逐层整合
全面考察校验
cn.agent_instruction: 遇到难题先拆：拆到最小可解单元，解决一个封装一个，最后组装并检验整体。
cn.source_text: 勒内·笛卡尔《谈谈方法》（原文未标注书名）。

en.name: Cartesian Thinking Model
en.description: Doubt every claim, decompose hard problems layer by layer, rebuild easy-to-hard, then verify exhaustively.
trigger: Facing a complex problem with no entry point
Need to verify a popular claim
avoid_when: When fast intuitive judgment is required
transform: Accept nothing lightly
Decompose the problem into modules
Integrate from easy to hard
Verify comprehensively
en.agent_instruction: When facing a hard problem, decompose it to the smallest solvable units, solve and encapsulate one by one, then assemble and verify the whole.
en.source_text: René Descartes, Discourse on the Method (book title not cited in the source text).

cn.name: 展望理论
cn.description: 人们基于参考点而非绝对财富评估得失：获利时规避风险，损失时偏好冒险，且对损失更敏感。
trigger: 解释看似不理性的风险选择
设计定价、谈判、激励方案
transform: 找到对方的参考点
用损失框架还是收益框架重构选项
警惕确定效应与迷恋小概率
cn.agent_instruction: 设计选择时先找参考点：把选项描述成'得到'还是'失去'，会改变人们的风险偏好。
cn.source_text: 丹尼尔·卡内曼与阿莫斯·特沃斯基提出。

en.name: Prospect Theory
en.description: People evaluate gains and losses relative to a reference point: risk-averse in gains, risk-seeking in losses, and losses loom larger.
transform: Find the reference point
Reframe options as gain or loss
Beware certainty effect and small-probability obsession
en.agent_instruction: When designing choices, find the reference point first: framing an option as a 'gain' or a 'loss' changes risk appetite.
en.source_text: Daniel Kahneman and Amos Tversky.

cn.name: 无知之幕
cn.description: 设计规则时假设自己不知道自己将处于哪个位置，从而推演出公平的原则。
trigger: 设计制度、规则、分配方案
transform: 想象不知道自己是谁
推演出对最弱势者最有利的方案
以此检验规则是否公平
cn.agent_instruction: 制定规则前问自己：如果我不知道自己会是谁，我还愿意接受这条规则吗？
cn.source_text: 约翰·罗尔斯（John Rawls）1971 年提出。

en.name: Veil of Ignorance
en.description: Design rules as if you did not know which position you would occupy, yielding fair principles.
transform: Imagine not knowing who you will be
Derive the option best for the worst-off
Test rules for fairness
en.agent_instruction: Before setting a rule, ask: if I did not know who I would be, would I still accept it?
en.source_text: Proposed by John Rawls in 1971.

cn.name: 帕金森定律
cn.description: 工作会膨胀以填满可用于完成它的全部时间。
avoid_when: 创造性工作需要探索时间时
transform: 设定紧而合理的时间盒
按交付价值而非忙碌程度评估
定期检查膨胀的修饰性工作
cn.agent_instruction: 给一个任务两周它就会用两周；先砍到两天的时间盒，看还剩多少是真工作。
cn.source_text: 西里尔·诺思科特·帕金森 1955 年在《经济学人》提出。

en.name: Parkinson's Law
en.description: Work expands to fill the time available for its completion.
avoid_when: When creative work needs exploration time
transform: Set tight, reasonable timeboxes
Evaluate by delivered value, not busyness
Audit decorative work regularly
en.agent_instruction: Give a task two weeks and it will take two weeks; cut the timebox to two days and see what real work remains.
en.source_text: C. Northcote Parkinson, The Economist, 1955.

cn.name: 霍夫斯塔特定律
cn.description: 事情总是比你预期的要长，即使你已经考虑了霍夫斯塔特定律。
trigger: 任何跨步骤协作的任务估算
transform: 基于历史数据而非乐观想象估算
接受不可压缩时间
为递归的不确定性再留缓冲
cn.agent_instruction: 估完时间后默认再乘一个系数——你已经在估算里纠正过的乐观，还不够。
cn.source_text: 侯世达《哥德尔、艾舍尔、巴赫》（原文未标注）。

en.name: Hofstadter's Law
en.description: Things always take longer than you expect, even when you take Hofstadter's Law into account.
transform: Estimate from historical data, not optimism
Accept incompressible time
Buffer for recursive uncertainty
en.agent_instruction: After estimating, multiply by a factor—the optimism you already corrected for is not enough.
en.source_text: Douglas Hofstadter, Gödel, Escher, Bach (not cited in the source text).

cn.name: 布鲁克斯定律
cn.description: 向进度落后的软件项目增加人手，只会让它更加延期。
avoid_when: 项目早期、任务高度可并行时
transform: 识别落后原因是范围还是人力
砍需求、砍范围优先
加人先算沟通成本
cn.agent_instruction: 落后项目的正确动作是砍范围，不是加人——新人 ramp-up 和沟通成本会吃掉贡献。
cn.source_text: 弗雷德里克·布鲁克斯《人月神话》（原文标注 2023/7/4）。

en.name: Brooks's Law
en.description: Adding people to a late software project makes it later.
trigger: Considering adding staff to a late project
avoid_when: Early-stage projects with highly parallelizable tasks
transform: Diagnose whether the cause is scope or staffing
Cut scope first
Compute communication cost before adding people
en.agent_instruction: The right move for a late project is cutting scope, not adding people—onboarding and communication eat the contribution.
en.source_text: Frederick Brooks, The Mythical Man-Month (noted 2023/7/4).

cn.name: 康威定律
cn.description: 组织设计的系统，是其内部沟通结构的复制品。
trigger: 想用架构反向调整组织
transform: 把系统架构与组织沟通结构对照
用逆康威定律：想做什么架构，先调组织结构
强架构师角色部分抵消
cn.agent_instruction: 系统哪里别扭，就去组织结构图里找对应的沟通别扭；想改系统，先改组织。
cn.source_text: Melvin Conway，1967（原文未标注年份）。

en.name: Conway's Law
en.description: Organizations design systems that mirror their communication structures.
trigger: Department walls appearing in system architecture
transform: Map system architecture to communication structure
Use inverse Conway: change the org to get the architecture
A strong architect partially offsets it
en.agent_instruction: Where the system is awkward, find the matching communication awkwardness in the org chart; to change the system, change the org first.
en.source_text: Melvin Conway, 1967.

cn.name: 坎宁安定律
cn.description: 在互联网上获得正确答案的最佳方式不是提问，而是发布一个错误答案。
trigger: 在成熟社区快速验证假设
avoid_when: 新手聚集、无人纠错的社区
代价高的故意传播错误
transform: 把假设以断言形式发布
等待纠正并收集论据
致谢并修正
cn.agent_instruction: 想验证一个判断，可以放出你的版本等打脸——但只在有人愿意纠正你的地方用。
cn.source_text: 以 Ward Cunningham（Wiki 发明者）命名。

en.name: Cunningham's Law
en.description: The best way to get the right answer on the internet is not to ask a question, but to post a wrong answer.
trigger: Quickly testing a hypothesis in a mature community
avoid_when: Beginner-heavy communities with no one to correct
When spreading errors is costly
transform: Post your assumption as an assertion
Collect the corrections and reasoning
Acknowledge and fix
en.agent_instruction: To test a judgment, put your version out and wait to be corrected—but only where people will correct you.
en.source_text: Named after Ward Cunningham, inventor of the Wiki.

cn.name: 斯特金定律
cn.description: 任何事物 90% 都是垃圾——评价一个领域要看它最好的 10%。
trigger: 'XX 都是垃圾'式的全盘否定
评估一个新领域值不值得进入
transform: 识别领域基数与平庸的普遍性
找该领域最好的 10% 来评价
同样审视自己是否属于 90%
cn.agent_instruction: 不要因为随机看到的 90% 就否定一个领域；评价它，去找它最好的 10%。
cn.source_text: 科幻作家西奥多·斯特金（Theodore Sturgeon）提出（回应'科幻都是垃圾'）。

en.name: Sturgeon's Law
en.description: Ninety percent of everything is crap—judge a field by its best ten percent.
trigger: Blanket dismissals like 'all X is garbage'
Assessing whether a new field is worth entering
transform: Recognize the base rate of mediocrity
Find the field's best 10% to judge it
Check whether your own output is in the 90%
en.agent_instruction: Do not dismiss a field based on a random 90% sample; to evaluate it, find its best 10%.
en.source_text: By science fiction writer Theodore Sturgeon (in reply to '90% of science fiction is crap').

cn.name: 扎温斯基定律
cn.description: 每个程序都在持续扩展，直到能读邮件为止；不能这样扩展的程序会被能扩展的取代。
trigger: 工具类产品开始平台化
transform: 识别产品是否正在走向'读邮件'
评估每个新功能对维护力的吞噬
为小工具保留 Unix 式的克制
cn.agent_instruction: 警惕你自己产品的'读邮件时刻'——它标志功能蔓延开始吞噬维护能力。
cn.source_text: Jamie Zawinski 对软件功能蔓延的描述。

en.name: Zawinski's Law
en.description: Every program expands until it can read mail; those that cannot are replaced by those that can.
transform: Spot whether the product is heading toward 'reading mail'
Assess each feature's drain on maintainability
Keep Unix-style restraint for small tools
en.agent_instruction: Beware your own product's 'reads mail' moment—it marks feature creep starting to eat maintainability.
en.source_text: Jamie Zawinski's description of software feature creep.

cn.name: 海勒姆定律
cn.description: 当 API 的用户足够多时，文档承诺什么都不重要——系统的所有可观察行为都会被人依赖。
trigger: 修改被广泛使用的接口或实现
想修复一个'非预期'行为
avoid_when: 新系统、内部系统用户很少时
transform: 把任何可观察行为视为契约
变更默认是破坏性的
最小化 API 表面积并给迁移路径
cn.agent_instruction: 改任何被广泛依赖的东西之前，先假设某个下游正在依赖你要改的那个行为。
cn.source_text: Google 工程师 Hyrum Wright 提出。

en.name: Hyrum's Law
en.description: With enough API users, it does not matter what you promise in the contract—every observable behavior will be depended upon.
trigger: Modifying widely used interfaces or implementations
avoid_when: New or internal systems with few users
transform: Treat every observable behavior as a contract
Assume changes are breaking
Minimize API surface and provide migration paths
en.agent_instruction: Before changing anything widely depended on, assume some downstream system relies on exactly the behavior you are about to change.
en.source_text: Proposed by Google engineer Hyrum Wright.

cn.name: 普赖斯定律
cn.description: 任何群体中，一半的工作由人数平方根的那部分人完成。
transform: 估算 √n 的核心贡献者
识别并留住关键的少数
避免误判不可见的支持性工作
cn.agent_instruction: 100 人的团队大约 10 人做了一半的活——找出你的 √n，把资源投给他们，同时别误伤支持性角色。
cn.source_text: Derek de Solla Price 在科学文献计量中的发现。

en.name: Price's Law
en.description: Half of the work in any group is done by the square root of the number of people in it.
trigger: Assessing output concentration in a team
transform: Estimate the sqrt(n) core contributors
Identify and retain the critical few
Avoid misjudging invisible support work
en.agent_instruction: In a 100-person team about 10 people do half the work—find your sqrt(n), invest in them, and do not harm invisible support roles.
en.source_text: Derek de Solla Price's finding in scientometrics.

cn.name: 林格尔曼效应
cn.description: 群体中个体的生产力随群体规模增大而下降：协调损失加社会惰化。
avoid_when: 目标清晰、贡献可见、强协作的小团队
transform: 控制团队规模
让每个人的贡献可识别
减少协调层级
cn.agent_instruction: 人越多人均贡献越小——默认用小团队，并让每个人的产出可见。
cn.source_text: 法国农业工程师 Ringelmann 的拉绳实验。

en.name: Ringelmann Effect
en.description: Individual productivity declines as group size grows: coordination loss plus social loafing.
trigger: Declining per-capita output in large teams
avoid_when: Small teams with clear goals and visible contributions
transform: Keep teams small
Make each person's contribution identifiable
Reduce coordination layers
en.agent_instruction: More people means less output per person—default to small teams and make everyone's work visible.
en.source_text: French agricultural engineer Ringelmann's rope-pulling experiment.

cn.name: 古德哈特定律
cn.description: 一项指标一旦成为目标，它就不再是好指标。
transform: 指标组合使用
定期检查指标与实际目标的背离
保留不可优化的定性判断
cn.agent_instruction: 任何用于考核的指标都会被'优化'——问一句：这个指标还代表它原本想衡量的事吗？
cn.source_text: 经济学家 Charles Goodhart 提出。

en.name: Goodhart's Law
en.description: When a measure becomes a target, it ceases to be a good measure.
transform: Use metric portfolios
Audit divergence between metric and goal
Keep ungameable qualitative judgment
en.agent_instruction: Any metric used for assessment will be gamed—ask: does this number still represent what it was meant to measure?
en.source_text: By economist Charles Goodhart.

cn.name: 吉尔布定律
cn.description: 任何你需要量化的东西，都可以找到某种测量方法，这总比完全不测量要好。
trigger: 需要驱动改进但缺数据
avoid_when: 粗糙度量制造虚假精确感时
测量成本超过收益时
transform: 拒绝'无法度量'的借口
先上粗糙的度量
与古德哈特定律配合：测但防博弈
cn.agent_instruction: 代码质量没法直接测？先测缺陷密度、圈复杂度、返工率——粗糙的测量好过不测量。
cn.source_text: Tom Gilb（软件工程度量先驱）提出。

en.name: Gilb's Law
en.description: Anything you need to quantify can be measured in some way, which is better than not measuring at all.
avoid_when: When crude metrics create false precision
When measurement cost exceeds benefit
transform: Reject the 'unmeasurable' excuse
Start with crude metrics
Pair with Goodhart: measure but prevent gaming
en.agent_instruction: Cannot measure code quality directly? Start with defect density, cyclomatic complexity, rework rate—crude measurement beats none.
en.source_text: By Tom Gilb, software engineering metrics pioneer.

cn.name: 墨菲定律
cn.description: 凡是可能出错的事，就一定会出错——小概率事件在足够重复后必然发生。
trigger: '应该不会出问题'式的侥幸心理
transform: 假设故障必然发生
设计 fail-safe、冗余、熔断
把'应该不会'视为危险信号
cn.agent_instruction: 没做备份的东西一定会坏、没设限额的资源一定会耗尽——设计时按'必然出错'来做。
cn.source_text: 工程版概率思维（原文未标注具体人物）。

en.name: Murphy's Law
en.description: Anything that can go wrong will go wrong—rare events become inevitable with enough repetition.
transform: Assume failure will happen
Design fail-safe, redundancy, circuit breakers
Treat 'should be fine' as a red flag
en.agent_instruction: Whatever you did not back up will break; whatever you did not rate-limit will be exhausted—design assuming failure.
en.source_text: Engineering version of probabilistic thinking (no person cited in the source text).

cn.name: 逆向思维
cn.description: 从目标或失败结果倒推条件：不问'怎样成功'，先问'怎样必然失败'，然后避开它。
avoid_when: 缺少基本事实，无法建立合理的倒推条件
transform: 先定义目标或失败结果
倒推出关键条件与风险
逐条设防
cn.agent_instruction: 先明确目标或可能的失败结果，再倒推关键条件、风险和可采取的步骤。
cn.source_text: 数学家雅可比：'反过来想，总是反过来想'；芒格推崇的思维方法。

en.name: Inversion
en.description: Reason backward from a goal or failure state: instead of asking 'how to succeed', ask 'how to guarantee failure' and avoid it.
avoid_when: There is not enough information to define plausible conditions
transform: Define the goal or failure state
Work backward to identify conditions and risks
Defend against each
en.agent_instruction: Start from the goal or a plausible failure state, then work backward to identify key conditions, risks, and practical steps.
en.source_text: Carl Jacobi: 'Invert, always invert'; a method championed by Charlie Munger.

cn.name: 第二层思维
cn.description: 在'会怎样'之后再问一句'然后呢'，推演结果的结果。
trigger: 一阶后果很舒服的决策
竞争激烈、预期博弈的场景
avoid_when: 过度推演导致分析瘫痪时
transform: 写出一阶后果
逐层推演二阶、三阶后果
特别审查'人人都这么做'时的均衡结果
cn.agent_instruction: 每个决策前问'然后呢'：这个动作的后果会引发什么新的后果？
cn.source_text: 霍华德·马克斯《投资最重要的事》对第一层/第二层思维的区分。

en.name: Second-Order Thinking
en.description: After asking 'what happens', ask 'and then what', reasoning through consequences of consequences.
avoid_when: When over-thinking leads to analysis paralysis
transform: Write down first-order outcomes
Derive second- and third-order consequences
Scrutinize the equilibrium when 'everyone does it'
en.agent_instruction: Before each decision ask 'and then what': what new consequences will this action's outcomes trigger?
en.source_text: Howard Marks' distinction between first-level and second-level thinking in The Most Important Thing.

cn.name: 第一性原理
cn.description: 把问题拆解到不可再分的基本事实，再从零重建解决方案，而不是靠类比。
trigger: 类比思维触及天花板时
avoid_when: 大多数日常问题——类比更快且足够
时间和资源不允许深度拆解时
transform: 否定默认假设
拆到物理/逻辑上成立的基本事实
从零重建方案
cn.agent_instruction: 遇到'大家都这么做'时，问一句：这件事本质上是什么？物理上成立的边界在哪里？
cn.source_text: 源自亚里士多德，因马斯克（火箭原材料成本仅为售价 2%）而流行。

en.name: First Principles
en.description: Break a problem down to irreducible basic facts and rebuild the solution from scratch instead of reasoning by analogy.
trigger: 'It has always been done this way' pricing or practice
avoid_when: Most everyday problems where analogy is fast and sufficient
When time and budget forbid deep decomposition
transform: Challenge default assumptions
Reduce to physically/logically basic facts
Rebuild from zero
en.agent_instruction: When facing 'everyone does it this way', ask: what is this thing fundamentally, and where are its physical limits?
en.source_text: From Aristotle, popularized by Elon Musk (rocket raw material cost at 2% of sale price).

cn.name: 理解世界的三个层次：从事件、局势到结构
cn.description: 事件是表象，局势是趋势，结构才是根因；在结构层发力才有杠杆。
trigger: 只会'救火'想找到杠杆解
avoid_when: 小问题不值得下沉到结构层分析时
transform: 事件层：发生了什么
局势层：一直在发生什么
结构层：什么导致了局势，在结构层做设计
cn.agent_instruction: 反复出现的问题，答案一定在上一层。问自己：这是第几次发生？
cn.source_text: 彼得·圣吉《第五项修炼》、梅多斯《系统之美》的系统思考框架。

en.name: Three Levels of Understanding: Events, Trends, Structure
en.description: Events are surface, trends are patterns, structure is the root cause; leverage lives at the structural level.
avoid_when: Small problems not worth structural-level analysis
transform: Events: what happened
Trends: what keeps happening
Structure: what drives the trends—design there
en.agent_instruction: For recurring problems, the answer lies one level up. Ask yourself: how many times has this happened?
en.source_text: Systems thinking framework from Peter Senge's The Fifth Discipline and Donella Meadows' Thinking in Systems.

cn.name: 安全边际
cn.description: 为不可知和错误留出缓冲：建承重 3 万吨的桥，只通行 1 万吨的车。
transform: 承认预测必有误差
买入/设计/承诺都打折扣
让错误变得可承受
cn.agent_instruction: 你的预测一定会错，问题是错的时候死不死——安全边际让错误可承受。
cn.source_text: 本杰明·格雷厄姆的价值投资概念（《聪明的投资者》）。

en.name: Margin of Safety
en.description: Leave buffer for the unknowable and for error: build a bridge rated for 30,000 tons, let only 10,000 cross.
transform: Admit predictions must err
Discount buying/design/promises
Make errors survivable
en.agent_instruction: Your prediction will be wrong; the question is whether the mistake kills you—margin of safety makes errors survivable.
en.source_text: Benjamin Graham's value-investing concept (The Intelligent Investor).

cn.name: 幂律分布
cn.description: 少数事件贡献大多数结果，平均值在这个世界里基本失效。
trigger: 风投组合、内容流量、城市人口等高度不均的领域
transform: 识别领域是否幂律分布
放弃平均思维
全力提高命中右尾的概率和次数
cn.agent_instruction: 不要用'平均案例'规划人生和事业；先问你的领域结果是不是幂律的。
cn.source_text: 二八定律是幂律的特例（原文未标注出处）。

en.name: Power Law
en.description: A few events produce most of the results; averages fail in power-law worlds.
trigger: Highly skewed domains: VC portfolios, content traffic, city sizes
transform: Check whether the domain is power-law distributed
Abandon average-based planning
Maximize the probability and number of right-tail hits
en.agent_instruction: Do not plan your life or career by the average case; first ask whether your field's outcomes follow a power law.
en.source_text: The 80/20 rule is a special case of power-law distribution.

cn.name: 纳什均衡
cn.description: 任何一方单独改变策略都不会变得更好的状态；均衡不等于最优。
trigger: '所有人都不满意但谁都动不了'的僵局
transform: 识别均衡状态
意识到个体理性导致集体非理性
改变规则与收益结构而非劝说个体
cn.agent_instruction: 当你发现谁都动不了时，你正处在纳什均衡里——解法不在劝说个人，而在改变规则。
cn.source_text: 约翰·纳什证明有限博弈中纳什均衡必然存在（原文未标注）。

en.name: Nash Equilibrium
en.description: A state where no party can improve by unilaterally changing strategy; equilibrium is not optimality.
trigger: Stalemates where 'nobody is happy but nobody moves'
Price wars, involution, tragedy of the commons
transform: Identify the equilibrium
See individual rationality producing collective irrationality
Change rules and payoffs instead of persuading individuals
en.agent_instruction: When nobody can move, you are in a Nash equilibrium—the solution is not persuading individuals but changing the rules.
en.source_text: John Nash proved equilibrium existence in finite games.

cn.name: 格雷欣法则
cn.description: 当'好的'与'坏的'被同一标准定价且可自由选择时，坏的会驱逐好的。
trigger: 组织里低标准工作驱逐高标准
avoid_when: 自由定价、信息充分的市场（可能反转）
transform: 识别'良币消失'现象
检查定价和奖惩机制
修复价格信号而非谴责个人
cn.agent_instruction: 看到'良币消失'，去查定价和奖惩机制哪里出了问题，而不是谴责个人品质。
cn.source_text: 托马斯·格雷欣 16 世纪提出（原文未标注）。

en.name: Gresham's Law
en.description: When the good and the bad are priced the same and freely choosable, the bad drives out the good.
trigger: Low-standard work driving out high standards in organizations
avoid_when: Free-priced, well-informed markets (may reverse)
transform: Spot the disappearing 'good money'
Audit pricing and incentive mechanisms
Fix price signals instead of blaming individuals
en.agent_instruction: When good money disappears, find the broken pricing and incentive mechanism instead of blaming personal character.
en.source_text: Sir Thomas Gresham, 16th century.

cn.name: 红皇后效应
cn.description: 共同进化的系统里大家都在进步，等于谁都没进步：你必须全力奔跑才能留在原地。
trigger: 军备竞赛式的相对竞争
transform: 区分相对竞争与绝对增量
评估赛道是否'留在原地'式
选对赛道比全力奔跑重要
cn.agent_instruction: 努力前先问：这个赛道是'留在原地'式的相对竞争，还是能创造增量的绝对竞争？
cn.source_text: 出自刘易斯·卡罗尔《爱丽丝镜中奇遇》红皇后的话；生物学上由 Leigh Van Valen 发展。

en.name: Red Queen Effect
en.description: In co-evolving systems everyone improves, which means nobody gains: you must run as fast as you can to stay in place.
transform: Separate relative competition from absolute gains
Assess whether the arena is 'stay in place' style
Picking the right race beats running hard
en.agent_instruction: Before striving, ask: is this a 'run to stay in place' relative competition or an absolute-gains arena?
en.source_text: From Lewis Carroll's Through the Looking-Glass; developed in biology by Leigh Van Valen.

cn.name: 公地悲剧
cn.description: 共享且有限的资源，在个体理性驱动下被过度使用直至毁灭。
trigger: 过度捕捞、地下水超采、环境污染
任何'收益归自己、成本大家摊'的场景
transform: 识别共享资源与成本分摊结构
选择解法：私有化、管制、社区自治
改变成本分摊结构而非谴责素质
cn.agent_instruction: 悲剧不是道德问题而是结构问题；指责'素质低'永远无解，改变成本分摊结构才有解。
cn.source_text: 加勒特·哈丁（Garrett Hardin）1968 年提出；奥斯特罗姆（Ostrom）发现社区可自组织规则。

en.name: Tragedy of the Commons
en.description: Shared, finite resources get overused to destruction under individually rational behavior.
trigger: Any 'gains are mine, costs are shared' setup
transform: Identify the shared resource and cost structure
Pick a fix: privatization, regulation, community governance
Change cost allocation instead of blaming morality
en.agent_instruction: The tragedy is structural, not moral; blaming 'low quality people' never solves it—changing cost allocation does.
en.source_text: Garrett Hardin, 1968; Elinor Ostrom showed communities can self-organize governance.

cn.name: 遍历性
cn.description: 群体平均收益不等于个体长期收益；对个体而言，'爆仓出局'是不可逆的。
trigger: 用'长期平均会回归'安慰承担毁灭性风险的自己
加杠杆、孤注一掷的决策
transform: 判断系统是否遍历
识别归零风险
先保证留在游戏里，再谈收益
cn.agent_instruction: 只要存在爆仓风险，群体平均对你就没有意义——你不能跟已经破产的人讲平均。
cn.source_text: 数学概念，因塔勒布《肥尾效应》在决策领域流行。

en.name: Ergodicity
en.description: The ensemble average is not the individual's time average; ruin is irreversible for the individual.
trigger: Comforting yourself with 'the long-run average reverts' while carrying ruin risk
transform: Judge whether the system is ergodic
Identify ruin risks
Stay in the game first, then talk returns
en.agent_instruction: Whenever ruin is possible, the ensemble average means nothing to you—you cannot talk averages with someone who went bankrupt.
en.source_text: Mathematical concept popularized in decision-making by Nassim Taleb (Statistical Consequences of Fat Tails).

cn.name: 林迪效应
cn.description: 不会自然消亡的事物，每多存在一年，预期剩余寿命反而增加一年。
trigger: 选择读什么、信什么、用什么
评估新事物 vs 旧事物
avoid_when: 易腐事物（人、动物、短期产品）
transform: 区分事物是否易腐
给经过时间检验的东西更高先验权重
对新生儿事物保持怀疑
cn.agent_instruction: 能活过 100 年的书往往还有 100 年可活；给经过时间检验的东西更高的先验权重。
cn.source_text: 纽约林迪餐厅的经验之谈，经塔勒布《反脆弱》推广。

en.name: Lindy Effect
en.description: For things that do not age (books, ideas, technologies), each additional year of survival implies a longer remaining life expectancy.
trigger: Choosing what to read, believe, or use
avoid_when: Perishable things (people, animals, short-lived products)
transform: Check whether the thing is perishable
Give time-tested things higher prior weight
Stay skeptical of newborns
en.agent_instruction: A book that survived 100 years probably has 100 more; give time-tested things higher prior weight.
en.source_text: Lindy's delicatessen heuristic, popularized by Nassim Taleb in Antifragile.

cn.name: 彼得原理
cn.description: 在层级组织中，员工倾向于晋升到其不能胜任的职位为止。
trigger: 优秀员工升任平庸管理者
transform: 区分'上一岗位的业绩'与'下一岗位的能力'
建立专业/管理双通道
用试岗、轮岗、回退机制校正
cn.agent_instruction: 晋升奖励的是当前岗位的胜任，但新岗位需要完全不同的能力——评估的是下一岗位的能力，不是上一岗位的业绩。
cn.source_text: 劳伦斯·彼得（Laurence J. Peter）1969 年提出。

en.name: Peter Principle
en.description: In hierarchies, employees tend to rise to their level of incompetence.
transform: Separate 'performance in the current role' from 'ability for the next'
Build dual IC/management tracks
Correct with trials, rotations, and demotions
en.agent_instruction: Promotion rewards competence in the current role, but the new role needs different abilities—assess next-role ability, not past-role performance.
en.source_text: Laurence J. Peter, 1969.

cn.name: 禀赋效应
cn.description: 一旦拥有某物，你对它的估值就会系统性上升。
trigger: 不愿卖出持仓、房子、自己写的代码
transform: 意识到'拥有'改变估值
问'若我现在没持有，愿意按现价买入吗'
谈判时切换到对方视角
cn.agent_instruction: 定期以'如果我现在没持有它，我愿意以现价买入吗'自检存量决策。
cn.source_text: 卡尼曼、塞勒等的经典咖啡杯实验（mug experiment）。

en.name: Endowment Effect
en.description: Once you own something, your valuation of it rises systematically.
trigger: Refusing to sell holdings, houses, or your own code
transform: Notice that ownership distorts valuation
Ask 'if I did not own it, would I buy it at this price'
Switch to the counterparty's perspective in negotiation
en.agent_instruction: Regularly audit existing positions with 'if I did not hold it today, would I buy it at the current price'.
en.source_text: Kahneman, Knetsch and Thaler's classic coffee mug experiment.
